title: HEALPix on both

dataset.name: DKRZ WCRP hackathon ICON d3hp003, P1D mean, HEALPix z7, atmosphere (Zarr)

left.label: ours (ortho-cog-viewer)
left.note: No cell renderer. The mesh/UV warp renderer takes a raster with a CRS and a geotransform; a HEALPix array is a 1D list of cells with no image to warp. Our DGGS work lives in trend.sst (S2 cells, Parquet aggregates) and is analytical only: it has no path to the screen either.

gap: We have DGGS on the analysis side (trend.sst: S2 cells plus Parquet) and no DGGS on the rendering side; gridlook has DGGS on the rendering side (HEALPix via the Zarr DGGS convention) and nothing on the analysis side. Neither can draw the other's cells.
bridge: A cell renderer that takes (cell id, value) pairs for any DGGS with a cell-to-vertices function: HEALPix from healpix-geo, S2 from s2geometry. HEALPix cell centres through delaunay is the smaller first step; S2 cells from trend.sst Parquet as a second source would turn this page into a draw.
